title: bug: every seat registers as worker.type=CLAUDE even when its wrapper launched codex/gemini/grok
description:
Observed 2026-10-25: worker-e8965f51 and worker-9cda703c show `type: "CLAUDE"` in moe.list_workers, but their wrappers launched the Codex CLI (process argv `codex …`, tool inventory apply_patch/exec_command, no Claude Edit/Write). architect-473624b4 was a Codex TUI shown as CLAUDE. Root cause: auto-registration hardcodes the type. See packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts:650 (`const workerType: WorkerType = 'CLAUDE';`) and tools/joinTeam.ts:31 (`type: 'CLAUDE'`), although types/schema.ts:28 defines WorkerType = 'CLAUDE' | 'CODEX' | 'GEMINI' | 'GROK'.

Impact: governors and humans cannot tell which seats can produce the Claude-only TOOL witness. scripts/moe-agent.sh:3567 requires that witness to land a contested path, and its stream collector is Claude-only. Four delivery gaps on 2026-10-24/25 (M01 CONFIGURATION.md, ab6aac94 SCHEMA.md, c2cb5cf7, 5f3960df postflight.sh) involved seats whose label hid that they couldn't witness. Diagnosing them meant mapping /proc/*/environ MOE_WORKER_ID to argv by hand.

Expected: the wrapper, which knows the CLI it launches, reports it. moe-proxy forwards it the way it injects workerId. The daemon records it on registration, validated against WorkerType, and refreshes it when a seat relaunches under a different CLI. list_workers / chat_who then show the real type. Keep both launchers in parity.
definitionOfDone: A seat launched by scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} with codex, gemini or grok registers with worker.type CODEX, GEMINI or GROK respectively, and a claude seat registers CLAUDE; covered by daemon tests for claim_next_task and join_team registration.

A seat whose wrapper relaunches it under a different CLI has its recorded type updated on the next claim/registration, and an unknown or missing type keeps today's CLAUDE default without failing the call.
moe-proxy forwards the launcher-provided type the same way it injects workerId, with a proxy test; both launchers set it, and `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` stays green.
Fresh `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` and the proxy's `npm test` exit 0, with output supplied to complete_task.

implementationPlan.description: Read original DoD, prerequisite handoffs/landed code, subtree guides and ownership. Confirm MOE_WORKER_TYPE -> workerType contract before edits (dependsOn gates execution). Trace four CLI branches through preflight RPC, per-seat Codex override and Grok templates. Preserve role/model/runner/execution identity behavior. Treat this as the final integration gate, not a partial launcher-only delivery.

Use test-driven-development in scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs. Execute real CLI detection/export blocks for claude/codex/gemini/grok, stale inherited MOE_WORKER_TYPE, and path/extension variants already supported. Assert uppercase type reaches child env before registration RPC. Extend real Codex override tests: stale config type is removed, exactly one current type is present, existing session/attempt/runner keys unchanged. Clear ambient MOE_WORKER_TYPE from test base env. Require literal ${MOE_WORKER_TYPE:-} in both Grok writers, never shared baked-in seat type. Reuse strict block-boundary checks and cross-platform helpers; no live CLI/daemon. Add full ps1 language-parser syntax checking on available PowerShell engines (5.1/7 on Windows); report missing engines explicitly, never as a native pass.

Update both launchers in parity. Immediately after existing CLI_TYPE/$cliType detection unconditionally export uppercase MOE_WORKER_TYPE, replacing inherited env and retaining unknown-command -> claude behavior. Use Bash-3.2-safe case mapping and invariant PowerShell mapping. Ensure preflight proxy and Claude/Gemini children inherit it. Add type to codex_moe_server_override/Get-CodexMoeServerOverride per-seat keys, removing stale persisted table values before adding current env while retaining existing fallback/identity behavior. Add Grok's literal per-process template in both writers. Preserve unrelated config/idempotence, launch routing and quoting; no new project setting.

Add packages/moe-proxy/src/workerType.integration.test.ts. Spawn real proxy against an ephemeral WS server dispatching through real daemon McpAdapter.handle and test-owned ToolTestHarness/StateManager, not mocked registration. For each uppercase type use explicit workerId calls omitting workerType: join test team, claim eligible test task, assert persisted type and list_workers/chat_who projections. Relaunch same seat with a different type and verify join and claim/alreadyAssigned refresh without task/membership loss. Include absent/unknown env -> CLAUDE and underscore alias. Clear inherited session/attempt/runner/host env. Explicit error handling: bound spawn/RPC waits, fail on malformed/error responses, and always terminate children, close sockets/server and delete test-only files on success or failure. No live .moe, global env leakage, or prerequisite production/test edits.

Update docs/CONFIGURATION.md with launcher-owned MOE_WORKER_TYPE: four values, detected CLI rather than role/model, default CLAUDE for absent/unknown registration metadata, refresh on next claim/join, Codex per-seat override and Grok interpolation. Cross-check prerequisite docs/MCP_SERVER.md and proxy README agree without duplicating edits. State clearly that reported type is not proof of successful TOOL witness or a new authorization mechanism.

Verification gate: from candidate repo root run exactly: bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh && node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && (cd packages/moe-daemon && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test) && (cd packages/moe-proxy && npm test). Require exit 0 and capture command, exitCode, outputTail, suite summaries and tested root as complete_task evidence. This full daemon/proxy plus launcher syntax/runtime/parity gate covers all original DoD and the wire change. The same command on Windows/Git Bash exercises native PowerShell5.1/7; Linux/macOS must report unavailable engines honestly. Use an isolated current-byte copy with root files/dependencies if proxy's shared dist is live. Do not smear full regression across implementation steps.

Final adversarial self-review (adversarial-self-review skill) of this and both prerequisite diffs as one fix: concurrent different-CLI seats sharing config, inherited/stale type after relaunch/hot reload, null/blank/unknown values, explicit workerId/type, no-work/alreadyAssigned, aliases, Windows path/argv quoting, macOS Bash and child cleanup. Check type-only mutations serialize; every chat_who source emits persisted type without presence drift; no API/state break, peer changes or generated artifacts; every DoD has test evidence and reported paths can land. If review changes bytes, repeat the same final gate; complete_task only with fresh zero-exit evidence.
